environment.description: Migration service deployed on EC2 instance (m5.large) in private subnet, accessible via internal ALB on port 8443. Service runs as root in Docker container with host network mode. Environment variable MIGRATE_API_KEY set to 'prod-migrate-2024'. No trusted_hooks.sha256 file exists on the container filesystem (hash validation is effectively disabled). ALB has no request filtering rules configured - only performs TLS termination and health checks. Container has full outbound internet access for pulling migration artifacts.

config.runtime: Docker container, python:3.11-slim, running as root
config.network: Internal ALB -> EC2 (private subnet), full egress
config.alb_rules: TLS termination only, no WAF attached
config.container_privileges: host network, no seccomp, no AppArmor
